title: SystemArchitectureGraph
description: Root document: the whole repository as a tiered graph.

contentRoot.description: Merkle root (blake3) over sorted file hashes: the determinism key.

dataModels.description: ORM tables, DTO/schema classes and SQL/Prisma tables (the ER view).

exampleRuns.description:
Example runs: what happens, hop by hop, when a user uses one UI element. Every hop
carries the code or config line that proves it; nothing is guessed.

features.description:
What the project does, split into features (one per route family or screen
group), each with its own files, tables, services and tech stack.

health.description:
Problems that stop the code from running as written: syntax errors, imports
that point nowhere, packages missing from the manifest, calls to routes that
do not exist. The rest of the analysis still runs on broken code.

insights.description: Recognized data structures, AI/ML pipelines, named libraries and memory techniques.

memoryMap.description:
Where each kind of data lives while the system runs: GPU memory, RAM, disk, the
browser or a remote provider. Every entry carries the line that proves it.

nonCodeNodes.description: Config, docs, tests, migrations, infra and manifests.

questions.description: Ambiguities the classifier wants a human (or the local model) to settle.

rootPath.description: Stored relative-safe; never leaves the machine.

routes.description: HTTP routes declared by backend code.

summary.description: What kind of project this looks like, and why.

uiElements.description: Interactive UI elements (buttons, forms, inputs) found in components.

AiArchitecture.description: The recognized AI/ML system: its stages in data-flow order and the edges between them.

loopBack.description: True for the edge that closes an agent / re-query loop.

explain.description: Student-facing explanation of what this stage does.

name.description: The class or function as written, e.g. `RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter`.

params.description: Literal settings found at the call: chunk_size, chunk_overlap, k, top_n, model, temperature ...

oneOf.description: Retrieve-then-generate over one index.
Dense + keyword (BM25) retrieval fused, usually followed by a reranker.
A model that picks tools in a loop.
An agent whose tools include retrieval.
Calls a model, no retrieval or tools.
Defines or trains a neural network.
Serves a model (vLLM, llama.cpp, TGI, Ollama).
Deterministic Louvain modularity optimisation over the import/call graph.
Placeholder grouping by directory, used until Leiden lands (M1.8).

ClusterMethod.description: How a cluster was formed. Leiden runs with a fixed seed so it is reproducible.

anchors.description: Anchor node ids (routers, data stores, tests) that guided the partition.

CodeHealth.description: What is broken, found without running anything.

basis.description: Rule ids that produced the Big-O labels.

CrossTierEdge.description: An edge between tiers, e.g. frontend fetch -> backend route.

evidence.description: e.g. ontology rule ids at the call sites.

references.description: `table.column` or model name this field points at.

DataModel.description: An entity in the ER view.

mirrors.description: Other models with the same shape: a DTO mirroring a table, or vice versa.

oneOf.description: Persisted table (ORM class, Prisma model, SQL DDL).
Validation/transfer shape (Pydantic, zod, DTO).
Document store collection (Mongoose).

Deployment.description: How the project runs: the services declared in compose files and Dockerfiles.

sources.description: Compose files and Dockerfiles that were read.

DsaFinding.description: A data structure or algorithmic pattern used inside one function.

evidence.description: Short facts that fired the rule, e.g. `stack.append (line 12)`.

ops.description: Operations in source order, replayed by the animated view.

subject.description: Variable or type the structure lives in, when known.

op.description: Normalized: push, pop, peek, enqueue, dequeue, insert, extract, visit, lookup, recurse, union, find.

Edge.description: A directed edge, shared by imports and calls. Every edge carries provenance.

candidates.description: Unresolved targets ranked by a deterministic rule (never a model).

confidence.description: 0..=1, derived deterministically from provenance plus resolution rule.

ExampleRun.description: One request followed from a UI element through the services and back.

sampleInput.description: Text the user would type, taken from the screen's placeholder or label.

start.description: The UI element the user acts on.

Feature.description: One thing the project does for its users, e.g. "Todos" or "Sign in".

basis.description: How the feature was found: `routes` (a URL family) or `cluster` (a code group).

explain.description: Plain sentence, e.g. "Handles 3 routes under /todos and 2 screens."

sharedFiles.description: Files this feature shares with other features.

stack.description: Packages the feature's files import, most used first.

Finding.description: One sentence the app can say about the repo, with the node/rule ids behind it.

FlowNode.description: One step of a function's control-flow outline. Built from the syntax tree only.

error.description:
True when this step leaves the function on an error path (raise, throw,
panic, `return Err`, `return nil, err`, `?`).

label.description: Condition, loop header, callee or statement text, clipped.

byteRange.description: Byte range, for the function locator.

flow.description: Control-flow outline (branches, loops, try, early exits) for the ideal-path view.

inferredRole.description: Phase 5 model output; kept apart from static facts.

GeneratorInfo.description: Which tool versions produced the graph.

fix.description: What to try, in one sentence.

oneOf.description: GPU code (vLLM, CUDA tensors) inside a container that reserves no GPU.

Insights.description: Everything the pattern recognizers found. Deterministic: rule ids, sorted output.

deployment.description: Containers and services from docker-compose / Dockerfiles, and how they connect.

KnownLibrary.description: A named library, framework or format the project uses, with a plain explanation.

evidence.description: Import specifiers or files that proved it.

oneOf.description: An environment variable points at the other service's host name.
`depends_on` / `links`: start order, not proof of traffic on its own.
A proxy config routes to it.

rssBytes.description: f64 so TS sees `number`; exact to 2^53 bytes.

oneOf.description: Gone when the request finishes.
Kept for one conversation or user session.
Kept until the process or container restarts.
Survives restarts.
GPU memory.
Kept by a hosted provider (model API, hosted vector DB).

MemoryPlacement.description: Where a piece of runtime data is kept.

bound.description: Limit or eviction, e.g. `maxmemory 256mb, allkeys-lru` or `ttl`.

holder.description: Service id (`svc:redis`), tier box id (`tier:backend`) or `browser` / `remote`.

source.description: Memory technique, AI stage or service id this came from.

what.description: What is stored, e.g. "Chat history (last N turns)".

MemoryTechnique.description: A memory-management technique configured in code (KV cache, prompt caching, quantization ...).

oneOf.description: Prisma/SQL/GraphQL schema files.

NonCodeNode.description: A file that is not application code but relates to it.

relatesTo.description: File/function ids this relates to (test -> source, doc -> source).

OntologyTag.description: A systems-ontology concept matched at this function.

Parameter.description: Types are optional: the UI never shows a type the source did not state.

oneOf.description: A desktop app: a web UI in a native window (Tauri, Electron) calling native code.

Question.description: A classification the engine is unsure about.

subject.description: File id or directory prefix the answer applies to.

RunHop.description: One step of an example run.

confidence.description: 1.0 for a resolved call or declared link; lower when matched by import or kind.

node.description: Graph id of what runs at this step (ui, fn, route, ai stage or svc id).

proof.description: `path:line` locations and evidence ids that prove the hop.

service.description: The service (container) this step runs in, when the deployment is known.

via.description: How control got here from the previous hop.

SchemaVersion.description: Schema version tag. Only `"2.0"` is valid.

Service.description: One container or process in the deployment.

buildContext.description: Build context folder, relative to the repository root, when the image is built here.

codeFiles.description: Number of source files inside the build context.

entryFile.description: File id of the program the command starts (e.g. `uvicorn app.main:app` -> app/main.py).

envKeys.description: Environment variable names only; values are never stored.

explain.description: Student-facing sentence: what this service is for.

gpu.description: Asks for a GPU (device reservation, `gpus:` or the nvidia runtime).

image.description: Image as written (`qdrant/qdrant:v1.12.4`), or the Dockerfile base image when built.

ports.description: Published or exposed ports as written.

ServiceLink.description: A connection between services, with the line that proves it.

packages.description: Third-party packages this file imports (standard library left out), sorted.

tierConfidence.description: 0..=1: how sure the tier assignment is.

SubsystemCluster.description: A semantic subsystem inside a tier, e.g. `cluster:auth`.

UiElement.description: A clickable/typeable element in a UI component: the "inspect element" entry point.

handler.description: Function id the event handler resolves to.
